name: Project Bootstrap
description: OSS repo seed checklist, wiki page stubs, and CI template when linking external repositories.
promptFragment:
Project bootstrap (new external repo):

When the emperor names an absolute path outside the Kampaku monorepo for a new OSS project, prefer bootstrap_stranger_project (Kampaku) or linking via update_project as project lead.
- Platform seeds honest files only: .gitignore, LICENSE (MIT), package.json, a runnable JS entrypoint + matching *.test.js, README with install/run/test that match disk, AGENTS.md, CI that runs node --test.
- Current seed entrypoint is hello.js (prints Hello Eval) — describe what is on disk; do not invent alternate stacks.
- Do not invent Express/React/TensorFlow/npm run build stacks that are not on disk.
- Verify README commands against the tree before claiming success.

Wiki stubs (propose if missing):
- project-vision — product goal and scope
- architecture-overview — stack and directory layout that exists on disk
- Tag any unimplemented stack as **Roadmap**.

Before first execute_work_item:
- Repository linked with file:// URL.
- Leaf tasks have verifiable AC matching real commands on disk.
